decision.interpretation: Document type word 'NGHỊ ĐỊNH' (Decree) forming the title block at its location, introducing the regulatory instrument.
Main title of the decree 'Quy định về hóa đơn, chứng từ' operating at its location to name the document's subject matter.
Chapter heading 'Chương I. NHỮNG QUY ĐỊNH CHUNG' introducing the first substantive section of the decree.
Article heading 'Điều 1. Phạm vi điều chỉnh' introducing the scope of regulation section.
Article heading 'Điều 2. Đối tượng áp dụng' introducing the applicable subjects section.
